title: Chapter 71 Purple Spirit Flower
content:
Chapter 71 Purple Spirit Flower

I saw a swarm of fist-sized bees, no less than dozens in number, flying over in unison.

Who did I offend?

Wang Shuo was very angry!

"Get ready to fight." He shouted and immediately took out the flame gun.

In the blink of an eye, the bee flew close.

Wang Shuo jumped up high and hit the bee with one shot, causing more than 140 damage.

Although the level of these bees is 10, their health value is only about 1,000.

As long as you can attack it, it's not difficult to kill.

However, they are flying monsters and are not very easy to hit.

Gong Ping accidentally got stung by a bee and lost 500 health points.

Everyone was shocked.

"Be careful, don't get stung!"

While Wang Shuo and others were fighting.

Those girls actually ran away right away!

This made Wang Shuo very angry.

At this moment, there was not even a single figure left, and Wang Shuo could only stare.

Wang Shuo checked the leader and remembered that his name was Oflan.

"Okay, I'll remember you, little girl!"

Continue to focus on the bees.

After a while, Wang Shuo took care of all the bees!

Some energy crystals exploded.

When you think of bees, there is definitely honey.

Monsters nowadays basically live in groups in fixed territories.

Considering that these bees were not too powerful, Wang Shuo planned to go and take a look.

After walking for about 10 minutes along the route that the bees took, a small canyon appeared in front of us.

In the canyon, tens of thousands of bees are flying around in the canyon.

"Goodbye, sorry to bother you!"

Wang Shuo just got cold feet and couldn't afford to offend him!

Run away before you provoke the bees.

Just when Wang Shuo was about to leave, Chang Gui suddenly said: "Lord, wait a minute. Take a closer look. There is something good on that big tree."

Wang Shuo stopped, took out his telescope, and carefully observed the big tree where the hive was located.

[Purple Spirit Flower: After taking it, agility +5, each person can only take 1 flower. 】

It is indeed a good thing and must be obtained.

But there were so many bees, which put Wang Shuo in trouble.

After Wang Shuo thought for a long time, he suddenly had an idea.

Not far away, the "Mud Pit" and "Hydro Mud" that had not been used for a long time were used.

He first used these two skills to dig a big hole.

The pit was filled with water to avoid bee attacks.

The bees were afraid of fire, so they put a lot of wood around the puddle.

Prepare to use fire to attack the bees.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but praise his careful plan.

"Get started." Wang Shuo ordered after he was ready.

Everyone worked together and quickly approached the big tree.

With just one blow, the tree felled.

Wang Shuo quickly put away the purple spirit flowers, and there were actually 17 of them.

He was delighted and a smile appeared on his face.

"ignition."

The Jianguo brothers waiting not far away immediately lit the wood.

"Before the bees can react, jump into the puddle immediately." Wang Shuo immediately said to Ayub and others.

At this time, Wang Shuo glanced at the beehive and put it away as well.

There was a huge queen bee next to him. Wang Shuo didn't hesitate and shot it in the head, taking it with him and escaping into the puddle.

Everyone immediately killed the queen bee with random knives.

In the blink of an eye, panicked swarms of bees were flying crazily in the air.

Want to find the culprit who destroyed their homeland.

"Exciting, so exciting!"

A blazing fire ring was lit around the pond, and countless bees rushed towards the fire fearlessly, hoping to sting the enemies who had invaded their home.

But, all this is in vain.
